einzeiler: A birthday trivia game featuring ten questions on Taylor Swift and Australian shepherds.
kurzfassung: Host Ali Lane presents a special birthday trivia game for Samantha from Chad. The episode includes ten questions divided evenly between The Eras Tour and Australian shepherds, followed by answers and a new bonus question. Listeners are invited to submit their own custom trivia requests via email.
stichpunkte: Review of the previous week's bonus question about the Gilmore Girls inn, The Dragonfly Inn
Introduction of a birthday trivia game dedicated to Samantha from Chad
Five trivia questions covering Taylor Swift's The Eras Tour
Five trivia questions covering the characteristics and history of Australian shepherds
Answers provided for all ten trivia questions, including tour details and dog breed facts
Announcement of a new Australian shepherd-themed bonus question for the following week
Call to action for listeners to submit custom trivia requests via email
